agent_id.description: Copy exactly the agent_id provided for this persona (numeric identifier only, no prefix and no name).

probabilities.description: One entry per option offered to this persona, without exception. The `probability` values must sum to exactly 100.

index.description: Index of the option, as shown in brackets.

mode.description: Mode of the option, copied from the option.

probability.description: Probability in % (0 to 100) that this persona picks this option. 0 if the option is impossible for them.
